entries.definition: a change in the body that may show illness
entries.example: A headache can be a symptom of several different problems.

entries.definition: a body temperature higher than normal because of illness
entries.example: The nurse asked how long the fever had lasted.

entries.definition: a sudden push of air from the throat
entries.example: His cough kept him awake during the night.

entries.definition: painful especially when touched or used
entries.example: My throat feels sore after speaking all afternoon.

entries.definition: a continuous dull pain
entries.example: The ache in her shoulder made lifting uncomfortable.

entries.definition: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by illness or injury
entries.example: Tell the doctor where you feel the pain.

entries.definition: physical harm to part of the body
entries.example: A knee injury stopped him from playing that week.

entries.definition: damage that breaks the skin or other body tissue
entries.example: The nurse cleaned the wound and covered it.

entries.definition: to become well again after illness or injury
entries.example: She needs time to recover after the operation.

entries.definition: care intended to improve a medical problem
entries.example: The doctor explained the treatment before it began.

entries.definition: a substance used to treat or prevent illness
entries.example: Ask the pharmacist how to take this medicine.

entries.definition: the measured amount of medicine taken at one time
entries.example: The label explains when to take each dose.

entries.definition: a medical instruction for obtaining and taking a medicine
entries.example: The pharmacist checked the prescription before preparing the medicine.

entries.definition: a person receiving medical care
entries.example: The patient asked the nurse to explain the instructions again.

entries.definition: a trained professional who provides medical care
entries.example: The nurse checked my temperature and asked about my symptoms.

entries.definition: a place where people receive medical advice or treatment
entries.example: The clinic offers appointments on Saturday mornings.

entries.definition: a routine examination to check someone’s health
entries.example: I booked a checkup before starting the new job.

entries.definition: a serious situation requiring immediate help or action
entries.example: The school has a clear plan for an emergency.

entries.definition: a vehicle that carries people needing urgent medical care
entries.example: The ambulance stopped near the hospital entrance.

entries.definition: illness caused by harmful organisms entering the body
entries.example: The doctor examined the cut for signs of infection.

entries.definition: a harmful body reaction to a usually harmless substance
entries.example: Please tell the restaurant about your food allergy.

entries.definition: to take air into and out of the lungs
entries.example: It is difficult to breathe comfortably in the smoky room.

entries.definition: the air taken in or released when breathing
entries.example: She paused to catch her breath after climbing the stairs.

entries.definition: physical activity done to improve health or fitness
entries.example: Walking to the market gives me regular exercise.

entries.definition: to extend the body or a body part gently
entries.example: I stand up to stretch after a long study session.

entries.definition: body tissue that tightens to produce movement
entries.example: The diagram shows a muscle working with a bone.

entries.definition: a place where two bones meet
entries.example: The ankle is a joint that helps the foot move.

entries.definition: one of the hard structures supporting the body
entries.example: The doctor checked whether a bone was broken.

entries.definition: the natural outer covering of the body
entries.example: Wear gloves if the cleaner irritates your skin.

entries.definition: something done regularly often without thinking
entries.example: Checking my phone before breakfast became a habit.

entries.definition: a usual order of activities
entries.example: A short walk is part of my morning routine.

entries.definition: the food and drink a person usually consumes
entries.example: Her diet includes a wide variety of vegetables.

entries.definition: the study or process of obtaining nourishment from food
entries.example: The lesson connects nutrition with everyday food choices.

entries.definition: an occasion when food is eaten
entries.example: We share one evening meal whenever our schedules allow.

entries.definition: one of the foods used to prepare a dish
entries.example: Read each ingredient if you have a food allergy.

entries.definition: an amount of food served to one person
entries.example: I ordered a smaller portion because I was not very hungry.

entries.definition: the desire to eat food
entries.example: A long walk gave us a good appetite.

entries.definition: feeling a need to drink
entries.example: I felt thirsty after working in the warm garden.

entries.definition: needing rest or sleep
entries.example: My eyes feel tired after several hours at the screen.

entries.definition: time spent relaxing or sleeping instead of working
entries.example: We took a short rest before continuing the walk.

entries.definition: the natural state of resting with reduced awareness
entries.example: A noisy street disturbed my sleep last night.

entries.definition: to become less tense or worried
entries.example: I relax by listening to music after work.

entries.definition: mental or emotional pressure caused by difficult demands
entries.example: Planning the journey early reduced some of my stress.

entries.definition: a person’s emotional state at a particular time
entries.example: Her cheerful mood made the long wait easier.

entries.definition: a reasonable arrangement between competing needs
entries.example: I am trying to find a better balance between work and rest.

entries.definition: to stop something from happening
entries.example: A good case can help prevent damage to your glasses.

entries.definition: to keep someone or something safe from harm
entries.example: The cover helps protect the equipment from dust.

entries.definition: to make something smaller or less
entries.example: Short breaks can reduce the discomfort of sitting too long.

entries.definition: to keep away from something or stop it happening
entries.example: I avoid carrying heavy bags on one shoulder.

entries.definition: in good physical or mental condition
entries.example: A healthy routine includes time for sleep and rest.
